visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Swap In Place Instead of Three Passes
visualizerParams.problemDescription: One loop counts the zeros, another copies the non-zero items, and a third appends the zeros to a new array. Do it in one pass by swapping each non-zero item to the next free position. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Swapping each non-zero item into the next free position moves the zeros back as a side effect, in one pass and without a second array.
